parts.text: $NVO Q3 2026: revenue DKK 79.2B, +6% Y/Y, driven by continued GLP-1 volume growth across operations, led by obesity. Operating margin 29.1%; net earnings DKK 16.7B. #earnings #pharma

$AVT Q1 FY27 (preliminary): revenue $10.7B, +82% Y/Y, driven by stronger demand across core verticals including industrial, aerospace, and defense. Operating margin 4.4%; net earnings $282M. #earnings #industrials

$CHSCP Q4 FY26: revenue $10.4B, +21% Y/Y, driven by strong oilseed crush and ethanol margins, alongside solid refining results. Operating margin 5.8%; operating cash flow $1.4B. #earnings #industrials
$MCD Q3 2026 (preliminary): revenue $7.2B, +1% Y/Y, driven by higher franchised margins. Operating margin reached 50.2% as global comparable sales grew. #earnings #restaurants
$AIG Q3 2026: revenue $7.4B, +17% Y/Y, driven by growth across commercial and personal insurance segments. Operating margin stood at 15.0%. #earnings #insurance
$CDW Q3 2026 (preliminary): revenue $6.8B, +18% Y/Y, driven by demand in data storage, servers, and devices. Operating margin 7.2%; operating cash flow $399M. #earnings #ecommerce

$KHC Q3 2026 (preliminary): revenue down 2% to $6.1B, with a 14.3% operating margin, as volume declined in North America meats and sauces amid higher procurement and logistics inflation. #earnings #consumer
$GWW Q3 2026 (preliminary): revenue $5.2B, +11% Y/Y, driven by growth in both High-Touch Solutions and Endless Assortment. Operating margin 16.0%; operating cash flow $661M. #earnings #industrials
$FLUT Q3 2026: revenue $3.9B, +2% Y/Y, with International comprising the largest revenue share. Operating margin was -30.7% as operating expenses outpaced revenue growth. #earnings #tech
$SWK Q3 2026: revenue $3.7B, -1% Y/Y, as portfolio streamlining continued. Operating margin expanded to 9.6% following ongoing supply chain actions. #earnings #industrials
$ADNT Q4 FY26 (preliminary): revenue $3.7B, +1% Y/Y, as operating expenses grew 37% against slow revenue growth. Operating margin -0.1%; net earnings −$0.02B. #earnings #autos

$KD Q2 FY27 (preliminary): Revenue $3.7B, down 2% Y/Y, supported by growth in Kyndryl Consult and hyperscaler-related revenue amid demand for AI modernization. Operating margin reached 3.1%. The company reaffirmed its fiscal 2027 outlook. #earnings #tech
